bullets.text: Q1 CR 94.1 against 96 aggregate goal; net income reflected CRs closer to 96 than 90; personal auto CR ~0.5 pts above pricing expectations; Commercial Auto CR 92.4, but March exceeded 100.

Severity trends in most coverages are increasing while frequency remains generally favorable. Reflecting increasing severity, Q1 experienced unfavorable reserve development. Amid unseasonably warm weather, motorcycle new applications and early loss reporting were both strong.
Written premium grew 7% in Q1, down slightly from 8% in Q4; Commercial Auto written premium up 13%, continuing double-digit momentum and reclaiming ground lost since 2008.

Capital position remains very strong; investment portfolio total return reached 3.3% YTD; portfolio held over $1.3B in unrealized gains; comprehensive income increased 17% YOY, providing a more meaningful performance measure.
Agency auto new business grew 8% on stronger conversion alongside modest renewal growth; Direct renewals were very solid, while Direct new business grew ~4% in Q1 but was essentially flat in March.

Appropriate rate action taken in several largest states running hot to protect long-term margin health; maintaining underwriting and pricing discipline remains paramount yet difficult amid rapid Commercial Auto book growth.

Snapshot device shipments set new quarterly highs with growing agent acceptance; Name Your Price aids quote tailoring; mobile quoting and servicing advanced alongside continued promotion of bundled Progressive Home Advantage policies.

A hardening market with industry profitability challenges feels like the playoffs. Prior-year industry growth was estimated around 1.5% with combined ratio north of 100, not expected to change significantly in Q1.
With significant advertising dollars attempting to incite consumers to shop, fresh and appealing messaging is essential to give consumers a compelling reason to show preference for Progressive.

The claims organization absorbed several weather catastrophes as tornadoes seem to follow unusual early weather patterns. Operationally, Progressive remained well-staffed in most areas, with Net Promoter Scores moving in the right direction.
